headline: Four typos are fixed and the sign-up buttons now say "Start your free trial"; this is a safe text-only change.
what_changed: Home page headline now reads "Every pattern" instead of "Every patern", and "attachements" is now "attachments".
Pricing page now says "hobbyists" instead of "hobbiests", and "14 day free trial" instead of "free trail".
The sign-up button on the home page and on all three pricing plans now says "Start your free trial" instead of "Get started free".
Where the buttons lead, their look and the page layout are unchanged. Nothing was changed beyond what you asked for.

risks.title: "Free trial" button on a plan that is already free
risks.explanation: The Starter plan costs $0, yet its button now says "Start your free trial". Some visitors may wonder what happens when a trial of a free plan ends, or think they will be charged later. This is wording only. Consider a different label for that one plan, such as "Get started free".

questions_for_developer: Can the Starter ($0) plan keep a different button label, so it doesn't look like a trial that ends?
good_news: The change is tiny: six lines of visible text. Links, styling and page structure are untouched.
The new button wording matches the pricing page's existing promise that all plans include a 14-day free trial.
